info.title: ShilpSetu API
info.description: One photo. One spoken sentence. A fair-priced, trust-verified listing — no typing, no middleman, no English required. · SIH 2026 · PS ID SIH26090 · Team HACKER LOBBY

delete.description: DPDP Act 2023: erasure. Media and PII are deleted; financial records are kept anonymised (legal retention).

post.description: Zero typing: each profile field answered by voice. Story audio is kept as-is and also transcribed.

get.description: Payout ledger: gross, platform fee, logistics, net — every rupee explained.
DPDP Act 2023: data principal's right to access — everything we hold about the artisan.

post.description: Onboard an artisan who may not own a smartphone. The artisan's spoken consent is recorded on the kiosk.

get.description: Batch-print certificate tags for an exhibition session (one page per item).

put.description: Append a chunk at `offset`. A chunk the server already has is ignored (safe to retry after a drop).

post.description: Single-request upload for good connections (web kiosk / tests).
Quick hints for the camera ('too dark', 'move closer'). Advisory only — never blocks capture.
Create a listing from one spoken description + photo(s). Idempotent per device capture.

patch.description: Artisan edits (from the device). Device wins for these fields on later AI re-runs.

post.description: Voice answers to the AI's follow-up questions ('What is it made of?' ...). Re-runs extraction + price.
'Change price' by voice ('make it 1,600') or number. The breakdown shows exactly what moves.
Step 4, one tap: publish to the storefront, issue the signed certificate, queue ONDC catalog sync.

get.description: For each queued capture on the device: Queued / Processing / Needs review / Ready / Live, plus the product id.

post.description: Transparent what-if: how a fair price is built from these inputs (used by kiosk operators and the admin).

get.description: Public 'How this price is built' for a live listing.
Anyone can verify certificates offline with this Ed25519 key.

post.description: Artisans accept / decline (one tap or IVR key), pack and ship; buyers cancel; courier/admin mark delivered.
Logistics-partner webhook stub: marks a shipped order delivered (settles the artisan payout).
Dev-only UPI sandbox: simulates the buyer completing payment and returns what the SDK would return.
Buyer views / add-to-cart / orders / returns — these retrain the price and ranking models.
Telephony webhook (Twilio/Exotel form-encoded). `digits_so_far` travels in the callback URL.
Admin / demo: walk the IVR menu without a phone line (e.g. digits='12' = Hindi, hear earnings).
Artisan replies '1' / '2' to the new-order SMS to accept / decline their most recent pending order.
In-app 'ask a helper to call me' — same helpdesk queue as IVR menu option 3.

get.description: Anonymised, aggregated collective analytics (a revenue stream for govt / bulk buyers): state x craft.
Market opportunity (public numbers) + platform impact. Public: shown on the admin Impact page and README.

post.description: Gateway fan-out: forwards a BAP search to registered BPPs (here, ShilpSetu).

get.description: What the apps need at start-up: languages, categories, tile behaviour, fair-price policy.
